title: Future Tense 4: Process or Result - Choosing Your Future
description: Choosing between the two futures: буду читать for ongoing or habitual action, прочитаю for one bounded result. The same choice viewed in the past tense for contrast.
descriptionRussian: Выбор между двумя формами будущего: буду читать — процесс или привычка, прочитаю — один завершённый результат. Для контраста то же различие показано в прошедшем времени.
intro: Now you choose, and the choice is not new: it is the same process-versus-result decision you already make in the past tense, pointed forwards. If you would say 'I was reading' you want the two-word future; if you would say 'I read it' you want the one-word one. A few verbs have no perfective partner at all and only ever take the two-word form.
rules: Aspect choice in past and future is the SAME logic. Process / habit → impf. Completed bounded result → pf. The triggers are identical: duration cues, habit cues, and result cues.
Aspect determines which future construction to use. Impf → буду + impf inf. Pf → pf synthetic future (same conjugation as the present, applied to a perfective verb).

Verbs like быть, любить, знать and хотеть have no everyday perfective partner, so the imperfective future is the only future they have: 'Я буду любить'. (Полюбить and захотеть do exist, but they mean 'come to love' and 'start wanting', a change of state rather than the same action completed.)

The same impf vs pf cues that decide aspect in the past also decide it in the future: 'я читал час' impf past matches 'я буду читать час' impf future; 'я прочитал' pf past matches 'я прочитаю' pf future.
examples: Антон читал журнал час. (Anton was reading a magazine for an hour.) Duration cue 'час' → impf past.
Антон прочитал журнал. (Anton read the magazine and finished it.) Result claim → pf past.
Я буду читать книгу всё утро. (I will be reading the book all morning.) Duration cue → impf future.
Я прочитаю книгу до конца недели. (I will read the book by the end of the week.) Bounded deadline → pf synthetic future.
Маша часто писала Антону. (Masha often wrote to Anton.) Habit cue 'часто' → impf past.
Маша напишет Антону завтра. (Masha will write to Anton tomorrow.) Single act → pf synthetic future.

items.promptEnglish: Anton will write (and finish) a letter.
items.explanation: Recap from Lesson 3. 'Anton will write and finish' is a single bounded result, so the pf synthetic future for 3sg: напишет. Today's drill mixes aspect choice across past and future.

items.prompt: Антон _____ журнал час, но не закончил.
items.promptEnglish: Anton was reading the magazine for an hour but didn't finish.
items.hint: Duration cue 'час'. Past tense (note 'не закончил'). Aspect?
items.explanation: Duration cue 'час' triggers the impf. The 'не закончил' confirms no completion. Past tense impf: читал.

items.promptEnglish: I will read (and finish) the book by the weekend.
items.hint: Bounded deadline 'до выходных'. Future tense. Aspect?
items.explanation: 'До выходных' is a bounded deadline (the action must finish by then), so pf future. 1sg pf synthetic: прочитаю.

items.promptEnglish: Masha used to write to Anton every evening.
items.hint: Habit cue 'каждый вечер'. Past tense. Aspect?
items.explanation: Habit cue 'каждый вечер' triggers the impf. Past tense impf, fem (Маша): писала.

items.promptEnglish: Tomorrow I will write to Anton.
items.hint: Single bounded act of writing. Future tense. Aspect?
items.explanation: A single act of writing tomorrow is a bounded result. Pf synthetic future, 1sg: напишу.

items.promptEnglish: Anton will often be at work.
items.explanation: Habit cue 'часто' triggers the impf. Future tense impf: буду работать paradigm; for 'Антон' that's будет работать.

items.hint: Working at a job is ongoing. Which future construction?
items.explanation: An ongoing state takes the imperfective future: будет работать.

items.promptEnglish: Anton was reading a magazine for an hour.
items.hint: The bare duration 'час' is a process cue. Which past?
items.explanation: A bare duration (час) triggers the imperfective past: читал журнал час.

items.promptEnglish: I will read the book by Friday.
items.hint: 'К пятнице' is a deadline. Deadlines call for which future?
items.explanation: A deadline (к пятнице) points at completion, so the perfective future fits: прочитаю.

blanks: Маша _____ книгу всё утро. (Masha will be reading the book all morning.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Duration cue 'всё утро' triggers the impf. Future tense impf: 3sg будет читать.

errorCorrection.sentence: Антон часто написал Маше прошлым летом.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Anton often wrote to Masha last summer.
errorCorrection.explanation: The habit cue 'часто' (often) demands the imperfective: писал. Написал is perfective and claims a single completed writing event, which contradicts 'often'. The same trigger that picks impf in the present picks impf in the past: habit → imperfective.

errorCorrection.sentence: Лена будет прочитать эту статью за час.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Lena will read this article in an hour.
errorCorrection.explanation: 'За + accusative' marks a bounded completion-time ('in an hour to finish'), which calls for the perfective. Russian's perfective future is synthetic, one word: прочитает. Будет + infinitive exists only for the imperfective (будет читать).

errorCorrection.sentence: Дети посмотрят мультфильмы каждый день этим летом.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: The children will watch cartoons every day this summer.
errorCorrection.explanation: The habit cue 'каждый день' (every day) demands the imperfective. The imperfective future is two words: будут + impf inf = будут смотреть. Посмотрят is a perfective ('they will watch [once, through]') and cannot describe a daily habit.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Masha read the book over the weekend (and finished it).
minimalPairs.explanation: 'За выходные' is a completion-time cue ('over the weekend'), triggering pf. Маша is fem, so прочитала. Читала would describe ongoing reading without a finish claim.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Tomorrow Anton will read (and finish) the article.
minimalPairs.explanation: A single bounded act with a definite reading completion → pf synthetic future. Прочитает (3sg). 'Будет читать' would imply ongoing reading without a finish.

reviewVocab.definition: verb aspect (the impf vs pf distinction; the same logic operates in past and future)
reviewVocab.example: Вид глагола виден в паре 'читать / прочитать': 'читать' имперфективный (процесс), 'прочитать' перфективный (результат).

reviewVocab.definition: result (the meaning of a perfective verb: completed, bounded action with a clear endpoint)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Я прочитаю книгу за час' слово 'прочитаю' выражает результат: книга прочитана за конкретное время.

reviewVocab.definition: habit (a recurring or regular action; triggers the imperfective in both past and future)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Маша часто писала Антону' слово 'часто' указывает на привычку, поэтому глагол стоит в имперфективном виде.
